title: Vendor Email: Ticket #SV-40418, N-07 and N-11 Parts Shipped

fields.subject: Ticket #SV-40418 – N-07 / N-11 parts SHIPPED – PO confirmation required
fields.body:
Hello Brennan County Emergency Management,

Good news! The replacement parts for service ticket #SV-40418 have shipped.

- N-07 Pine Hollow: replacement rotator motor (qty 1)
- N-11 Clarks River Bridge: 24 V battery bank (qty 1 set)

Ship date: 12/11/2026
Estimated delivery: 12/15/2026

ACTION REQUIRED: Please reply to confirm PO 2026-0871 and a site access contact for both locations by 12/14/2026 at 12:00 PM CT. If we do not receive confirmation by then, your install slot will move to January 2027.

This is an automated message from our service ticketing system. Do not reply after hours expecting a technician. Replies are reviewed Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT.

Thank you for choosing Bluegrass Signal Systems.
